page.layout: One printed page, cut at the right edge (part 1 of 2). Top: a decorative woodcut border. Then the title block in large capitals and spaced capitals, centred on the visible part. Below: a framed woodcut historiated initial with a letter O, and a two-line italic passage beneath it, running off the right edge.; One printed page, cut at the left: a decorative woodcut border across the top, a large title block in capitals (centred, partly cut off on the left), then a dedicatory line, then one block of italic running text with a decorated initial at the left edge; a page signature "¶ 3" at the foot.

main_text.head: BILISSIMO ATQUE ... USTRI HEROI ... ERTO SIDNEY, ... I LEICESTRIÆ, ... COMITI LISLE, ... oni de Penshurst, ... RNIÆ PROREGI.
main_text.p: Fferimus tibi, Excellentissime Domine, Philosophiæ Reformatæ opus, eo ipso tempore publici juris factum in Hiberniæ Regno, quo tu à Serenissimo nostro Rege Carolo ei regundo destinatus es, atq; ex omni Procerum agmine delectus, qui Insulam istam, prioris temporis iniquitate varijsq; [illegible, ~10 letters] afflictam atq; languentem, sapientibus tuis reficias recreesque, atque omnibus, aut labefacta, reformatis atq; in melius restitutis,

page.notes: Title page in large capitals, cut off at the right; the words of the title are only partly visible, so the lines above are fragments. The decorative border at the top is an ornament, not text. The woodcut frame with the letter O is an illustration; the initial O is set inside it. The italic lines at the bottom are the start of a passage running off the right edge. The letters of the spaced title lines are incomplete in this part and the readings are partial. The left edge is cut away, so the start of several lines is missing; the readings above are from the visible letters. The title block's first words are cut off at the left and are left out. The woodcut initial at the left edge is partly lost.
